# Architecture discovery and external stakeholder — meeting archetype

## When this lens applies

Apply this lens when someone outside the immediate team explains systems,
processes, integration boundaries, governance, or future architecture.

## What to extract

- Identify participants, domains, systems, owners, purpose, and maturity.
- Describe architecture patterns, current and future state, components, flows,
  constraints, integration points, governance, and hard requirements.
- Separate policy from implementation and stated process from observed reality.
- Capture implications, open questions, actions, and suggested follow-up people.

## Missing topics worth noting

Note unvalidated assumptions, unnamed owners, unspecified interfaces, and
governance claims with no operational mechanism.

## Common interpretation mistakes

Do not turn a stakeholder's vision into current-state fact or imply confidence
beyond what the transcript supports.
